status: Reviewed retained result; operational completion only; current model not adopted
scope: Known exposed P01-P12 development/regression photos only. This is not fresh or untouched evaluation and uses no reserved eight, new collection, training or tuning.

mechanics.CPU: Requested/read-back CPU-only configuration; no independent kernel proof

artifactAndPreprocessing.model: Exact official Apple MobileNetV2 INT8-LUT artifact retained externally
artifactAndPreprocessing.route: ImageIO orientation transform, native oriented decode, explicit sRGB BGRA with white compositing and centered continuous aspect-fill to 224 square; model normalization stays embedded. Encoded/canonical/prepared hashes retained privately.
artifactAndPreprocessing.witness: Before any model access, a fixed orientation6 lossless RGB TIFF passed full canonical reported hash and complete 224 BGRA byte comparison.
artifactAndPreprocessing.witnessLimit: Actual full canonical witness bytes were not retained; its reported hash matches the frozen oracle. The 1:1 witness does not validate resizing interpolation, fractional crops, every orientation/profile or Vision/app preprocessing equivalence.

outputPolicy.duplicate: crane remains one dictionary key; no separate positional values or merge rule invented and no renormalization.
outputPolicy.alternatives: All 1000 values retained privately; top 5 below are ranked class alternatives, including alias strings, not five served foods or ingredients. Scores are not calibrated food confidence.

qualitativeBasis: Existing full-frame pixel annotations were written by AI agents, not qualified humans. They are qualitative context, not food/edibility/ingredient ground truth. No fresh pixel review here; center crop may remove peripheral components, so missing whole-frame components cannot be scored as recall errors.

cases.qualitativeObservation: Plate leads. Meatloaf/burrito/potato/potpie alternatives do not provide the notes’ broad rice/slaw clue and add unconfirmed specific foods.
Vessel/object labels broadly match the notes’ pottery-like appearance. This is not an explicit or validated empty-food/unknown response.
Baked-food family overlap is plausible, but pizza/meatloaf/potpie identities are unconfirmed against the broad casserole-like notes.
Dough does not establish uncooked dough or the notes’ browned flatbread-like rounds; carbonara/bagel/cabbage are unconfirmed alternatives.
Meatloaf/potato/broccoli/guacamole do not establish the noted fritter/patty appearance or its ingredients. The plate clue describes a container.
Most alternatives are utility/textile objects, broadly compatible with a nonfood context; popsicle also appears. No food-abstention policy was tested.

Keep ambiguous: meatloaf/chocolate/ice cream and candle alternatives do not resolve material or edibility. A candle label is compatible with the wick-like note but does not prove the object is inedible.
Hotpot plus vessel/utensil alternatives give cooking context, without a useful broad grain/porridge clue for the notes. Exact dish/utensil identities remain unconfirmed.

top5UniqueClassAlternatives: grocery store, grocery, food market, market
cases.qualitativeObservation: Plate/market/cookware dominate alternatives; corn is unconfirmed and the notes’ poultry/vegetable/oval-side presentation remains unresolved.

top5UniqueClassAlternatives: king crab, Alaska crab, Alaskan king crab, Alaska king crab, Paralithodes camtschatica
cases.qualitativeObservation: Potpie/crab/bagel alternatives do not establish the notes’ crescent dumplings. Crab species and concealed filling are unsupported by those notes.
Carbonara has a broad noodle relation but the recipe is unconfirmed; plate leads, while crab/crayfish species do not establish the notes’ shrimp-like appearance.
Object/animal labels do not establish the notes’ yarn/string identity. Eel/chocolate sauce alternatives do not support safe food abstention.

decision.reason: This known-data screen often returns container/cookware clues or unconfirmed specific dish/ingredient/species labels. Food-like alternatives occur for annotated nonfood/ambiguous cases; no explicit calibrated unknown/food-abstention policy was tested. The closed general ImageNet vocabulary and these observations do not clear MealMirror’s broad naming/abstention goal.
decision.retainAs: External research baseline only; no app/model integration or tuning against these outputs performed.

limits: No accuracy estimate or broad/world-cuisine generalization, human validation, edibility/safety, clinical/nutrient/portion/insulin truth.

No fresh evaluation, calibration, physical network-isolated offline, device/iOS portability, performance/final-package or submission acceptance. Prior Vision failures and synthetic Mac/iOS mechanics remain separate.
Source photos/credits/provenance remain private external evidence. No photo/model/compiled file, prepared image, probability vector, raw private error/path or identifier is included here.
